questions.q: Under which scheme will the Ministry of Social Justice provide funding in the MoD–Social Justice MoU on cantonment senior citizen welfare?
questions.explain: The ministry offers guidance, expertise and funding under AVYAY.

questions.q: Where is India hosting the 62nd Session and Ministerial Meeting of the International Coconut Community (ICC)?
questions.explain: The ICC meeting is in Kochi, Kerala, from 17 to 20 November 2026.

questions.q: A 16th-century palm-leaf manuscript of which text, kept at Mysuru's Oriental Research Institute, was inscribed on the UNESCO MOWCAP Regional Register?
questions.explain: Kautilya's Arthashastra manuscript was inscribed on 5 November 2026.

questions.q: Who discovered the Arthashastra manuscript at the Oriental Research Institute in 1905?
questions.explain: Scholar-librarian Rudrapatnam Shamasastry found it in 1905.

questions.q: The fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam (28 Nov–12 Dec 2026) will centre on which classical Tamil text?
questions.explain: The fifth edition will focus on the Thirukkural (1,330 couplets).

questions.q: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026 replaces which colonial-era rules?
questions.explain: It replaces the Aircraft Rules, 1937 and takes effect on 1 January 2027.

questions.q: Which nationality mark must Indian-registered aircraft display under the new aviation rules?
questions.explain: The mark 'VT' followed by a hyphen and three letters is mandated.

questions.q: What is the proposed SAF blending target for international flights by 2030 in the draft National SAF Policy?
questions.explain: Targets are 1% in 2027, 2% in 2028, 3% in 2029 and 5% by 2030.

questions.q: According to the World Bank estimate cited, India must raise its Female Labour Force Participation Rate to what level to become a developed nation by 2047?
questions.explain: FLFPR must reach 50%; it was 34.6% in September 2026.

questions.q: In which year was the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the oldest UN specialized agency, founded?
questions.explain: ITU was founded in 1865 and is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.q: Who proposed the Asia Oil Security Task Force at the Asia Zero Emission Community summit in Manila?
questions.explain: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi proposed it on 17 November 2026.

questions.q: Where is the 4th India–Japan 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue scheduled on 18–19 November 2026?
questions.explain: The dialogue is in Tokyo, co-chaired by Rajnath Singh and S. Jaishankar.

questions.q: The 23rd ASEAN–India Summit in Manila adopted a Joint Statement on which subject?
questions.explain: The Joint Statement on Disaster Management was adopted on 17 November 2026.

questions.q: What was India–Thailand bilateral trade in FY 2025–26?
questions.explain: Trade was USD 21.49 billion, up 12.6% over the previous year.

questions.q: In a normal water year, how much water must Karnataka release at Biligundlu as per the Supreme Court's 2018 modification of the Cauvery tribunal award?
questions.explain: Karnataka must release 177.25 TMC at Biligundlu in normal years.

questions.q: What is the financial outlay of the Karnataka Marine Biotechnology Policy 2026–2031?
questions.explain: The five-year policy has an outlay of ₹120 crore.

questions.q: The 27th Hornbill Festival, known as the 'Festival of Festivals', will be held at which place in Nagaland?
questions.explain: It is held 1–10 December 2026 at Kisama, about 12 km south of Kohima.

questions.q: Karnataka rolled out AI education for Class IX students in how many government high schools?
questions.explain: AI education started on 16 November in 1,800 government high schools.

questions.q: AIIMS Delhi performed India's first open fetal surgery to correct which condition?
questions.explain: The surgery corrected lumbosacral myelomeningocele in a 25-week-old fetus.

questions.q: WHO recommends how much folic acid daily up to 12 weeks of pregnancy to reduce neural tube defect risk?
questions.explain: 400 micrograms daily can reduce the risk by nearly 75%.

questions.q: Who is the ex-officio President of the CSIR Society?
questions.explain: The Prime Minister is the ex-officio President; the DG chairs the Governing Body.

questions.q: IISc researchers paired isoniazid with which antibiotic against drug-resistant TB?
questions.explain: The isoniazid–vancomycin pair cut bacterial growth by over 90% in most isolates.

questions.q: Manu Bhaker was elected to which body for the 2026–2030 term?
questions.explain: She was one of six athletes elected to the ISSF Athletes Committee.

questions.q: At Paris 2024, Manu Bhaker became the first athlete from independent India to do what?
options: Win three medals in a career
Win two medals at a single Olympics
questions.explain: She won two bronze medals at Paris 2024.

questions.q: What role will MS Dhoni take for Chennai Super Kings from the 2027 IPL season?
questions.explain: Dhoni retired from playing IPL on 17 November 2026 and becomes Team Mentor.

questions.q: As captain, how many IPL titles did Dhoni win with CSK?
questions.explain: CSK won in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023 under him.

questions.q: How many runs did Dhoni score in his IPL career across 278 games?
questions.explain: He scored 5,439 runs with 24 half-centuries.

questions.q: The RBI cancelled the Certificates of Registration of how many NBFCs through orders issued in October 2026?
questions.explain: 49 CoRs were cancelled; with 14 surrenders, 63 entities were affected.

questions.q: India's WPI-based inflation in October 2026 was:
questions.explain: WPI inflation rose to 12.29% from 11.39% in September 2026.

questions.q: Which group has the largest weighting in the WPI basket (63.13%)?
questions.explain: Manufactured Products carry the largest WPI weight at 63.13%.

questions.q: What was India's overall unemployment rate (age 15+) in October 2026 as per the PLFS monthly report?
questions.explain: It fell to 4.9% from 5% in September 2026.

questions.q: What penalty did the CCPA impose on the operator of ExportersIndia.com for listing regulated explosives?
questions.explain: Two penalties of ₹10 lakh each made a total of ₹20 lakh.

questions.q: Which company did the RBI direct to comply with mandatory NBFC-UL listing norms on 16 November 2026?
questions.explain: Tata Sons was classed NBFC-UL in September 2022; Tata Trusts hold about 66%.

questions.q: Which Andhra Pradesh location is among the five proposed greenfield shipbuilding clusters?
questions.explain: The five clusters are Dugarajapatnam, Kuchhadi, Dighi, Kendrapara and Thoothukudi.

questions.q: Which authority banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass on 10 November 2026?
questions.explain: DGFT moved the export policy from 'Free' to 'Prohibited'.

questions.q: Indian Oil got approval to commercially supply SAF from which refinery?
questions.explain: The Panipat refinery in Haryana; IOC is India's first certified SAF supplier.

questions.q: What is the currency code for offshore-traded renminbi, used in the HKEX Offshore RMB Bond Index?
questions.explain: Offshore yuan is CNH; onshore mainland currency is CNY.

questions.q: BSE's BANKEX futures became the first Indian sectoral index futures to get approval from which US regulator?
questions.explain: The US CFTC approved it after a 45-day expedited review.

questions.q: What is the annual cap per resident individual under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS)?
questions.explain: The cap is USD 250,000 (about ₹2 crore); LRS began in 2004 under FEMA 1999.

questions.q: Which Indian Navy ship took part in the bilateral exercise JAIMEX 2026 with Japan?
questions.explain: Stealth frigate INS Sahyadri (F49) exercised with Japan's JS Ise.

questions.q: The 8th India–Myanmar Naval Exercise IMNEX-26 concluded at which port?
questions.explain: It ended in Visakhapatnam on 14 November 2026 with a Harbour and a Sea Phase.

questions.q: BITS Hyderabad students developed which pocket-sized radio for the Indian Army?
questions.explain: 'Krath Control' weighs under 180 grams and works without cellular networks.

questions.q: 'Varuvaaiy', nominated for a Grammy in the Best Global Music Performance category, is in which language?
questions.explain: It is the first Tamil song ever nominated for a Grammy (69th Grammy Awards).

questions.q: Sunny Varkey, who got the 2026 Eisenhower Global Transformation Award, launched which annual prize of $1 million in 2015?
questions.explain: He launched the annual $1 million Global Teacher Prize in 2015.

questions.q: Who was appointed Chairperson of the National Sports Board (NSB) on 16 November 2026?
questions.explain: Retired IAS officer Devesh Chaturvedi was appointed; P. K. Garg joined as a Member.

questions.q: India's first Mountain Ecology Congress, 'Processual Mountains 2026', will be held in which place?
questions.explain: It is at Pookode, Wayanad, from 10 to 12 December 2026.

questions.q: Which country was newly inducted into LeadIT, launched in its third phase (LeadIT 3.0) by India and Sweden at COP31?
questions.explain: Brazil was formally inducted as the newest LeadIT member.

questions.q: COP31 is being hosted in which city, from 9 to 20 November 2026?
questions.explain: COP31 is at the Expo Center in Antalya, Türkiye.

questions.q: How many bird species did the Uttarakhand Bird Count 2026 (UBC-2026) record across the state?
questions.explain: 394 species were recorded across all 13 districts, lower than 408 in 2025.

questions.q: The traditional Karbi dance Nimso Kerung set a Guinness World Record at which place?
questions.explain: Over 15,000 artistes performed at KASA Stadium, Diphu on 16 November 2026.
